description: A four-shaft 2/2 straight twill, 8 ends by 8 picks, written for a SINKING shed (Rising Shed=false: each treadle's marks are the two shafts that go down), with no warp spacing in the file. On a jack loom, which raises the shafts you tie, that is advice to tie the other squares, never an error; on a countermarch loom it is how to tie the two sets of lamms. With no sett the width and reed are not checked, until the weaver enters one.
